title: Use Magnific 3D Motion to generate a 3D space and define camera motion, then…
content: Use Magnific 3D Motion to generate a 3D space and define camera motion, then export the 3D motion and import it into Seedance 2.5 as a motion reference to make a new scene follow the same camera movement.
tips: Use Magnific 3D Motion to generate a 3D space and define camera motion, then export the 3D motion and import it into Seedance 2.5 as a motion reference to make a new scene follow the same camera movement.

es.content: Usa Magnific 3D Motion para generar un espacio 3D y definir el movimiento de la cámara; luego exporta el movimiento 3D e impórtalo en Seedance 2.5 como referencia de movimiento para que una nueva escena siga el mismo desplazamiento de cámara.

fr.content: Utilisez Magnific 3D Motion pour générer un espace 3D et définir le mouvement de la caméra, puis exportez le mouvement 3D et importez-le dans Seedance 2.5 comme référence de mouvement afin de faire suivre à une nouvelle scène le même déplacement de caméra.

ja.content: Magnific 3D Motionを使って3D空間を生成し、カメラモーションを定義します。その後、3DモーションをエクスポートしてSeedance 2.5にモーション参照としてインポートし、新しいシーンに同じカメラ移動を追従させます。

ko.content: Magnific 3D Motion을 사용해 3D 공간을 생성하고 카메라 모션을 정의한 다음, 3D 모션을 내보내 Seedance 2.5에 motion reference로 가져와 새 장면이 동일한 카메라 움직임을 따르도록 합니다.

pt.content: Use o Magnific 3D Motion para gerar um espaço 3D e definir o movimento da câmera; em seguida, exporte o movimento 3D e importe-o no Seedance 2.5 como uma referência de movimento para fazer uma nova cena seguir o mesmo movimento de câmera.

zh.content: 使用 Magnific 3D Motion 生成 3D 空间并定义 camera motion，然后将 3D motion 导出并导入到 Seedance 2.5 中作为 motion reference，让新场景跟随相同的 camera movement。
